R,C=20,20
g=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
ones={(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)}
# Rectangle
for r in range(2,9):
    for c in range(9,16): g[r][c]=2
# Horizontal rays, stop in each direction at a 1-marker
for r in range(2,9):
    blockers=sorted(c for rr,c in ones if rr==r)
    left=max((c for c in blockers if c<9), default=-1)
    right=min((c for c in blockers if c>15), default=C)
    for c in range(left+1,9): g[r][c]=2
    for c in range(16,right): g[r][c]=2
# Vertical rays from rectangle, stop at marker on that column
for c in range(9,16):
    above=max((r for r,cc in ones if cc==c and r<2), default=-1)
    below=min((r for r,cc in ones if cc==c and r>8), default=R)
    for r in range(above+1,2): g[r][c]=2
    for r in range(9,below): g[r][c]=2
for r,c in ones:g[r][c]=1
import json
print(json.dumps(g))
